text: Data from a transmitter to a receiver. How can we do that? How can we impress information bits on the signal, the electromagnetic wave that travels from transmitter to receiver? Modulation. Okay, but I know you have got an ICT background. Okay, thanks. So modulation, modulation is the operation that allow us to impress bits on a signal, right? And we can do that by changing amplitude, or frequency, or phase of the signal. Okay. Also, we said at the receiver, when the power of the received signal is too low compared to noise interference, we may make mistakes. And we said there are techniques to help the receiver to receive correctly the information. A possible family group of techniques is the forward error correction.
